sourcePolicy: Local working tree, tests, diagnostics, scripts, RefPlan5, local Git history and the exact Phase 09 package runtime only; no remote Git.

phaseGate.input: Verified Phase 02 joint placement, Phase 03 topology, Phase 07 value/liveness/pressure, Phase 12 region and Phase 13 canonical loop/MII contracts.
phaseGate.output: A deterministic, solver-neutral, bounded modulo-schedule witness with typed attempts, exact shared W=8 placement, resource reservations, lifetime pressure summary and independent witness revalidation.
phaseGate.authorityBoundary: The scheduler emits a kernel witness only. It does not mutate Canonical IR, emit carrier bytes, legalize runtime execution, allocate physical registers, publish, commit or retire.
phaseGate.deterministicFallback: Unknown, unsupported, stale, temporally infeasible, resource-infeasible, exact-placement-infeasible, pressure-infeasible and budget-exhausted cases preserve ExactBasicBlockFallbackOnly; budget exhaustion is never an infeasibility proof.

releaseDisposition.defaultEnabledScope: Explicit modulo-schedule witness API only; exact basic-block production scheduling and emitted artifacts remain unchanged.
releaseDisposition.releaseDisposition: Qualified as Phase 15 and Phase 16 input evidence only. Optimality claims, modulo expansion and production schedule emission remain disabled.

externalBaselineFailures.scope: LLVM adapter restore and downstream legacy build
externalBaselineFailures.cause: NuGet vulnerability service index https://api.nuget.org/v3/index.json was unavailable during the local qualification run.
externalBaselineFailures.impact: No restore or build error; pinned packages and compiled outputs completed successfully. One environmental warning was added to each affected build total.

nextDependencyGate.gate: Add a deterministic, solver-isolated exact scheduling oracle for bounded qualification subjects and report an independently checked optimality gap without placing solver dependencies in Core or changing production output.
